results.title: VQualA 2025 Challenge on Engagement Prediction for Short Videos: Methods and Results
results.snippet: This paper presents an overview of the VQualA 2025 Challenge on Engagement Prediction for Short Videos, held in conjunction with ICCV 2025. The challenge focuses on understanding and modeling the popularity of user-generated content (UGC) short videos on social media platforms. To support this goal, the challenge uses a new short-form UGC dataset featuring engagement metrics derived from real-world user interactions. This objective of the Challenge is to promote robust modeling strategies that capture the complex factors influencing user engagement. Participants explored a variety of multi-mo…

results.title: The 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index
results.snippet: Foundation model developers are among the world's most important companies. As these companies become increasingly consequential, how do their transparency practices evolve? The 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index is the third edition of an annual effort to characterize and quantify the transparency of foundation model developers. The 2025 FMTI introduces new indicators related to data acquisition, usage data, and monitoring and evaluates companies like Alibaba, DeepSeek, and xAI for the first time. The 2024 FMTI reported that transparency was improving, but the 2025 FMTI finds this prog…

results.title: VLA-Thinker: Boosting Vision-Language-Action Models through Thinking-with-Image Reasoning
results.snippet: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising capabilities for embodied intelligence, but most existing approaches rely on text-based chain-of-thought reasoning where visual inputs are treated as static context. This limits the ability of the model to actively revisit the environment and resolve ambiguities during long-horizon tasks. We propose VLA-Thinker, a thinking-with-image reasoning framework that models perception as a dynamically invocable reasoning action. To train such a system, we introduce a two-stage training pipeline consisting of (1) an SFT cold-start phase with cura…

results.title: Inference-Time Attention Steering for Vision-Language-Action Driving Models
results.snippet: Vision-language-action (VLA) driving models couple a reasoning stage with a diffusion-based trajectory decoder, but do not give a direct way to redirect attention toward safety-critical actors at inference time without retraining. We studied a bounded additive pre-softmax attention bias on the visual tokens of detector localized traffic actors on Alpamayo-R1's Qwen3-VL backbone. It is applied as a fail open forward pre-hook with no weight changes. On 50 lane-change scenarios from the Physical AI World Model Synthetic dataset. The trajectory decoder shows a monotonic dose response in the bias…

findings.point: VLA-Thinker 提出 "thinking-with-image reasoning" 架构，突破现有 VLA 模型仅用文本链式思维、将视觉输入视为静态上下文的局限，使模型能在长时任务中主动回看环境并消除歧义。
findings.evidence: 论文指出现有 VLA 方法依赖 text-based chain-of-thought reasoning，视觉输入被视为静态上下文，限制了长时任务中主动回看环境和消除歧义的能力；VLA-Thinker 引入 thinking-with-image reasoning 机制。
findings.attention: 中 | 刚发布的 arXiv 预印本，针对 VLA 核心架构痛点，但尚无同行评审与独立复现
findings.recommendation: ★★★☆☆ | 直接切中 VLA 视觉推理瓶颈，属架构层面创新，值得跟踪后续实验验证与开源情况

findings.point: 推理时注意力引导 在无需重训练前提下，通过在 Qwen3-VL backbone 的视觉 token 上施加有界加性 pre-softmax attention bias，实现对检测到的安全关键交通参与者的注意力重定向。
findings.evidence: 在 Alpamayo-R1 的 Qwen3-VL backbone 上实现 bounded additive pre-softmax attention bias，作用于 detector-localized traffic actors 的视觉 token，实现推理阶段的安全关键注意力引导。
findings.attention: 中 | 面向自动驾驶 VLA 的推理期干预机制，工程落地价值高，但仍为预印本且单一 backbone 验证
findings.recommendation: ★★★☆☆ | 解决 VLA 部署阶段安全可控性的实用技术，适合关注具身智能落地的工程团队跟踪

findings.point: 当前主流 VLA 模型普遍采用文本链式思维，视觉编码器输出仅作为静态上下文送入 LLM，缺乏在推理过程中动态聚焦、重读视觉信息的机制。
findings.evidence: VLA-Thinker 论文明确指出："most existing approaches rely on text-based chain-of-thought reasoning where visual inputs are treated as static context"，这限制了长时任务中的环境回看与歧义消除。

results.title: Open X-Embodiment: Robotic Learning Datasets and RT-X Models
results.snippet: Large, high-capacity models trained on diverse datasets have shown remarkable successes on efficiently tackling downstream applications. In domains from NLP to Computer Vision, this has led to a consolidation of pretrained models, with general pretrained backbones serving as a starting point for many applications. Can such a consolidation happen in robotics? Conventionally, robotic learning methods train a separate model for every application, every robot, and even every environment. Can we instead train generalist X-robot policy that can be adapted efficiently to new robots, tasks, and envir…

**增量判断**：推理期干预（Inference-Time Intervention）成为 2026 年新热点，解决“训练后不可控”的部署痛点。[2] 提出的有界注意力偏置可直接作用于检测器定位的 token，**无需重训练、延迟极低**，工程落地价值高；[3] 则从模型内部机制挖掘可解释性信号。两者均为预印本，**单一 backbone 验证，跨架构泛化性待核实**。> 待核实：在 OpenVLA/Octo/GR-1 等主流开源 VLA 上的迁移效果。

**增量判断**：[11] 首次系统量化**推理后端选择对闭环行为的因果影响**，打破“离线指标代替在线性能”的隐性假设。ONNX Runtime CUDA EP 相比 PyTorch+AMP 降低延迟，但可能引入数值差异导致策略分布漂移。**这是 VLA 落地工程的关键实证**，提示部署评测必须包含闭环 rollout 而非仅离线推理延迟。> 待核实：TensorRT、TVM、MNN 等其他推理加速方案在 VLA 上的同类闭环对比。

| **推理算力与延迟** | SmolVLA [11] 在 RTX 2060 6GB 上实测：ONNX 显著加速但改变闭环行为 | **边缘侧部署（<10W 功耗、<50ms 延迟）成为硬约束**，推理加速不再是纯工程优化，而是影响策略分布的核心超参 | [11] | 确定 |
| **视觉-语言-动作对齐机制** | 主流架构仍为“冻结 VLM + 动作头”或“全量微调”，对齐机制缺乏理论指导 | ATI-VLA [7]、ACoT-VLA [6]、VLA-Thinker [1] 同期涌现，**说明社区正从“拼接”转向“深度对齐机制设计”** | [1][6][7] | 较大概率 |

| **安全与可解释性** | 推理期注意力干预 [2][3] 刚起步，无形式化验证、无监管标准 | **自动驾驶/医疗/家庭服务等高风险场景将强制要求可解释性与干预机制**，倒逼架构重构 | [2][3] | 推测 |

**拐点预判**：**2026 下半年-2027 上半年**可能出现三个拐点——（1）首个**统一动作空间+跨本体零样本泛化**的 VLA 3.0 架构在 CoRL/RSS/ICRA 发布；（2）**闭环评测基准（如 SimplerEnv v2 / RoboBench 2.0）发布统一榜单**；（3）首个**通过功能安全认证（ISO 26262 / ISO 13849）的 VLA 控制器**在受限场景量产。> 待核实：上述预判的具体时间节点与主体团队。
